title: The military raid
content: Anyone else experience a military raid last night at the hub? Never seen this military before. Dressed in white. They were looking for specific people. I had to hide my face and force myself to walk up. I’ve been dreaming in this place for 20 plus years before and this has never happened. In the world I’m usually one helping people come and go. I help people with the tests and i have been journaling about this for a long time. Never once experienced this particular very awake military type presence in the world specifically looking for certain things. Anyone else?!
